g.text: A NAMED CLAIM AND ITS PROOF
Example test_next_working_day : next_working_day (next_working_day saturday) = tuesday.Proof. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.
simpl: both sides reduce to tuesday.
reflexivity: the two sides are equal; no goals remain.
A third route: extract an executable program
Gallina → OCaml, Haskell, or Scheme → compiled execution.
A proof connects the Gallina program to its specification.Execution still trusts extraction and the target-language compiler.
